displayTitle: Ash-Lad and the Troll’s Silver Ducks, Bedspread, and Gold Harp
description: An English retelling that stays close to the Norwegian folktale, keeping its brisk, rhythmic challenges as Ash-Lad outwits a lake-dwelling troll to steal silver ducks, a patchwork bedspread, and a joy-bringing gold harp.
tone: Folktale, witty, adventurous, and darkly comic
summary: Ash-Lad braves a troll’s lake and steals three wonders—silver ducks, a gilded bedspread, and a gold harp—by cleverness and nerve.
